description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores of different models across six datasets, comparing their performance in anomaly detection tasks. The horizontal axis lists the categories, representing the datasets SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "F1 Score (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, marked at intervals of 10. Each dataset is associated with a group of four bars, colored green, blue, purple, and orange, corresponding to the models MADLLM, MADLLM w/o prompt pool, MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding, respectively. The F1 scores for the models vary across the datasets; for instance, in the SMD dataset, all four models have scores around 90-92%, while in the WADI dataset, the scores are significantly lower, ranging from approximately 63% to 74%. The bars within each group are not stacked, and the chart does not display any specific sorting order among the datasets or models. The legend below the chart provides a clear mapping of the colors to the respective models. Overall, the chart presents a clear comparison of the performance of different models across various datasets.
